meta.name: elasticsearch
meta.description: Query and manage Elasticsearch or OpenSearch clusters via REST API. Search, index, and aggregate data using curl.

howto.what: 装上后,你能让 Claude 直接查询和管理 Elasticsearch 或 OpenSearch 集群。它能用 curl 调用 REST API 做搜索、写入、更新、删除文档,还能看集群健康和索引信息。需要先设置集群地址和认证信息。
howto.when: 当用户要求查询或管理 Elasticsearch/OpenSearch 集群,比如搜索文档、查看集群健康、写入数据时触发。需先提供集群地址或 API 密钥。

在 users 索引里搜 status 为 active 的文档

say.text: 统计 orders 索引每月的订单数量

howto.what_en: Claude can query and manage Elasticsearch/OpenSearch clusters via REST API using curl. It handles searches, document insert/update/delete, aggregations, cluster health checks, and index operations. Needs ELASTICSEARCH_URL or ES_API_KEY.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to query or manage an Elasticsearch/OpenSearch cluster, such as searching documents, checking cluster health, or writing data. Requires cluster URL or API key.

say_en.note: Claude calls _cluster/health and shows the result.

Count orders per month in the orders index.
